testcase.name: a round leaves the muzzle, not the eye, at the weapon's muzzle speed
the live round list is capped and clearable
a round cannot tunnel through the 14 unit tunnel roof
a round cannot hit the player who fired it on the way out
the exposed round list is a read-only view
nothing spawns without a shooter or a weapon
rounds expire instead of raining down somewhere else a second later
rounds stop at terrain and leave the world
firing into a wall you are touching produces no round at all
damage falls off with the path actually flown
a round that hits a player damages them once and disappears
ids are unique so the client can track a round across snapshots
